name: say-so
description: SaySo: low-latency Cloudflare-native spoken-intent authorization (Workers + Deepgram Nova-3 WebSocket + ReDimNet Container + SQLite Durable Objects).

scripts.build: pnpm build:wasm && pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @sayso/demo build
scripts.test:rust: cargo test --workspace && cargo test --manifest-path crates/voice-verdict/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path crates/speaker-service/Cargo.toml --lib
scripts.test:ts: pnpm --filter @seams/voice-verdict test && pnpm --filter @seams/sayso-client test && pnpm --filter @sayso/verifier-worker test
scripts.test: pnpm build:wasm && pnpm build:packages && pnpm test:rust && pnpm test:ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @seams/voice-verdict type-check && pnpm --filter @seams/sayso-client type-check && pnpm --filter @sayso/verifier-worker type-check && pnpm --filter @sayso/demo type-check
